conversion.role: Verified generated-normal component and normal-incidence F0 corrections; legacy BRDF approximation remains

generatedAsphaltNormal.sourceOrder: XZY; green is the surface normal
generatedAsphaltNormal.reason: Generator writes (-dhx,1,-dhy), but tangent-space mapping requires (-dhx,-dhy,1). Swap G/B only for these identified generated textures; retain sampling/strength.

conversion.phongF0: preserve original linear specular RGB through derived IOR and normalized tint; never multiply it by another default dielectric F0
conversion.roughness: preserve existing export mapping; Phong and GGX highlight shapes are not identical

plausible.role: Optional bounded dry-surface/dielectric proposal; not measured asset truth
plausible.baseColor: preserve bus, facade and terrain colors/textures/instance tints; metallic glazing's white specular color becomes reflection tint with a black diffuse proxy

reasons.grass: Retain texture variation while testing a dry rough surface; source mean roughness is approximately 0.26. Moisture/species and map authoring remain unmeasured.
reasons.glazing: Ordinary glass is dielectric; source white metallic color is a specular tint, not white diffuse paint. Use black diffuse with neutral reflection, retain source opacity/cutout, and do not invent transmission. This is an opaque reflection-layer approximation.
reasons.bus: Retain blue/black/gray identity. Gray rim uses a coated-surface approximation, not measured bare aluminum. Keep runtime toggles independent and unchanged.

bakeInvalidation: Source material, texture, shader, profile or visibility changes invalidate exported material caches and affected indirect-light bakes. No production promotion is performed.
